mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over three months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the previous month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of industrial production contraction (INDPRO below 100), a simultaneous decline in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deepening economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: industrial contraction and labor market stress
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE rises from prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and remains above this level for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past six months indicates a deteriorating labor market that suppresses consumer confidence and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE increases over six months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weak aggregate demand, lowering corporate profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and INDPRO decline from the previous month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105), a concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a supply-side disruption in construction that reduces overall economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: high industrial growth with housing contraction
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105 and HOUST declines from prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
